description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Cincinnati tri-state (OH-KY-IN) market (PTF-CINCINNATI-MARKET-FACTORY-001). Consumed by scripts/pettripfinder/assemble_netlify_bundle.py. Complete and self-contained: every number below is calibrated to THIS market's committed authority. This is a WORKER-PROPOSED first-pass package: zero identities have been adjudicated into hotel_policy_facts_cincinnati-oh.json this run, so this contract deliberately describes a zero-hotel, non-publishing market rather than force a false count.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, no held identity leaks, and every publish/tech gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and it makes no claim that any hotel has been verified pet-friendly -- all 121 of this first-pass census's confirmed identities are unresolved; zero are published.

identity_census.note: First-pass tri-state census: 74 IDENTITY_CONFIRMED (address recovered from an official county/regional visitor-bureau directory), 14 IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL (name+city+brand only), 33 IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED (name only). One PROPOSED pet-friendly observation exists (cincinnati-oh-proposed-observations.json) but is UNADJUDICATED and therefore not counted as verified. Zero VERIFIED_NO_PETS this run.

reconciliation.note: published_pet_friendly and verified_no_pets are both 0 because this worker run adjudicated nothing into hotel_policy_facts_cincinnati-oh.json or hotel_exclusions.json -- every brand official site attempted returned HTTP 403 to the worker's automated fetch tool, and the one independent-site PETS_ALLOWED observation obtained (Countryside Inn & Suites Mount Orab) is preserved as UNADJUDICATED pending fee-amount confirmation, per Phase 6's rule that worker proposals are not automatically production authority.

policy_package.note: Empty package (0 records) -- honest reflection of zero adjudicated identities this run, not a placeholder error.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: This market currently holds no seed rows at all -- there is no held/manual-review set to gate yet. The gate is derived and will start enforcing the moment a seed row is added.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor, and policy-comparison pages would live under /pet-friendly-hotels/cincinnati-oh/ once inventory exists. All 19 configured corridors are below their publication minimum with zero members -- none publish yet.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
